item.title: New Week, Another AI Coach: ai-finance-coach
item.description: A self-hosted coach for your household’s money. PSD2 bank sync through Enable Banking, an encrypted local database, a one-time login link or a passkey, and a language model that only ever receives redacted, pseudonymised, already computed figures. With real examples of what stays on your machine and what is sent.
